# Count what the rebel AI changed, into country variables.

		limit = { has_building = building_angkor_wat }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat } }
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_new add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }

			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { b:building_angkor_wat.level > var:rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat }
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = rpm_delta
					value = {
						value = b:building_angkor_wat.level
						subtract = var:rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat
					}
				}
				scope:rpm_player = {
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_expanded add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_levels_added add = scope:rpm_delta }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
					debug_log = "RPM expanded | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_angkor_wat | snapshot level [THIS.GetState.MakeScope.Var('rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat').GetValue|0]"
				}

			else_if = {
				limit = { b:building_angkor_wat.level < var:rpm_lvl_building_angkor_wat }
				scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_reduced add = 1 } }

					limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }

					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 4
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_compression_ignition_tractors } }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_compression_ignition_tractors } }
					scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_changes add = 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
						debug_log = "RPM pm changed | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_wheat_farm | group 2 | was pm_compression_ignition_tractors"
					}
				}
				else = {
					scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_blocked add = 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
						debug_log = "RPM pm blocked | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_wheat_farm | group 2 | pm_compression_ignition_tractors is no longer available"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_simple_farming } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_simple_farming }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_herring_meal_farming }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_soil_enriching_farming }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 3
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_fertilization } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_fertilization }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm0_building_wheat_farm = 4
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_chemical_fertilizer }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_no_secondary } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_no_secondary }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_citrus_orchards } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_citrus_orchards }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm1_building_wheat_farm = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_sugar_beets } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_sugar_beets }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tools_disabled } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tools_disabled }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tools } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tools }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_steam_threshers } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_steam_threshers }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 3
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tractors } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_tractors }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm
					var:rpm_pm2_building_wheat_farm = 4
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_compression_ignition_tractors } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_wheat_farm production_method = pm_compression_ignition_tractors }
				}
				}
			}
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_buildings add = 1 } }
		}
	}
	if = {
		limit = { has_building = building_white_house }
		if = {
			limit = { NOT = { has_variable = rpm_lvl_building_white_house } }
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_new add = 1 } }
			if = {
				limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
				debug_log = "RPM rebel-built | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house"
			}
		}
		else = {
			if = {
				limit = { b:building_white_house.level > var:rpm_lvl_building_white_house }
				save_temporary_scope_value_as = {
					name = rpm_delta
					value = {
						value = b:building_white_house.level
						subtract = var:rpm_lvl_building_white_house
					}
				}
				scope:rpm_player = {
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_expanded add = 1 }
					change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_levels_added add = scope:rpm_delta }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
					debug_log = "RPM expanded | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | snapshot level [THIS.GetState.MakeScope.Var('rpm_lvl_building_white_house').GetValue|0]"
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = { b:building_white_house.level < var:rpm_lvl_building_white_house }
				scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_buildings_reduced add = 1 } }
				if = {
					limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
					debug_log = "RPM reduced | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | snapshot level [THIS.GetState.MakeScope.Var('rpm_lvl_building_white_house').GetValue|0]"
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = { has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house }
			if = {
				limit = {
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house } }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house } }
					scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_changes add = 1 } }

					if = {

						debug_log = "RPM pm blocked | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | group 0 | pm_default_building_white_house is no longer available"
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 1
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_prestige_only } }
				}

					limit = { can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_prestige_only } }

						limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
						debug_log = "RPM pm changed | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | group 0 | was pm_monument_prestige_only"
					}
				}
				else = {
					scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_blocked add = 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
						debug_log = "RPM pm blocked | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | group 0 | pm_monument_prestige_only is no longer available"
					}
				}
			}
			else_if = {
				limit = {
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects } }
				}
				if = {
					limit = { can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects } }
					scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_changes add = 1 } }
					if = {
						limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
						debug_log = "RPM pm changed | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | group 0 | was pm_monument_no_effects"

						limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
						debug_log = "RPM pm blocked | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_white_house | group 0 | pm_monument_no_effects is no longer available"
					}
				}
			}
		}
		if = {
			limit = {
				OR = {
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 0
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_default_building_white_house }

					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_prestige_only } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_prestige_only }
				}
				AND = {
					has_variable = rpm_pm0_building_white_house
					var:rpm_pm0_building_white_house = 2
					NOT = { is_production_method_active = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects } }
					can_activate_production_method = { building_type = building_white_house production_method = pm_monument_no_effects }
				}
				}
			}
			scope:rpm_player = { change_variable = { name = rpm_sum_pm_buildings add = 1 } }
		}
	}
}

# Scope: state. Shrink Barracks back to the snapshot.
rpm_generated_restore_levels_army_state = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			has_building = building_barrack
			has_variable = rpm_lvl_building_barrack
			b:building_barrack.level > var:rpm_lvl_building_barrack
		}
		save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = rpm_target_level value = var:rpm_lvl_building_barrack }
		if = {
			limit = { has_global_variable = rpm_debug }
			debug_log = "RPM shrinking | [THIS.GetState.GetNameNoFormatting] | building_barrack | back to level [THIS.GetState.MakeScope.Var('rpm_lvl_building_barrack').GetValue|0]"
		}
		remove_building = building_barrack
		create_building = {
			building = "building_barrack"
			level = scope:rpm_target_level
			reserves = 1
		}
	}
}
